name: Smew's Ranch
creator: Smew
description: Smew's Ranch is a follow-up world from creator Smew, built as a lighter, more playful companion to Smew's Room. It has an amusement-park feel, featuring a large Ferris wheel, a roller coaster, and assorted throwable gadgets and toys for visitors to mess around with. Since its release it has steadily grown in popularity as a fun, low-pressure hangout spot.
